    "textPayload": "    message: \"<expr type=\\\"expression\\\" label=\\\"content\\\"/> Thank you for your patience, there — your initial results are in, and I've placed your affordability summary on your screen. <expr type=\\\"break\\\" label=\\\"300ms\\\"/> It brings together the income and savings targets you shared with me and the details from your credit review, and shows how your numbers compare with typical program guideline ranges. <expr type=\\\"break\\\" label=\\\"500ms\\\"/> One important note before we look at it together: this is an educational summary to help you explore — it is not a loan decision, and you can submit for the formal eligibility review at any time, no matter what these ranges show. <expr type=\\\"expression\\\" label=\\\"curious\\\"/> Would you like to walk through it together?\"",
